sources.note: The BMRS API documentation at bmrs.elexon.co.uk states APIs are public and no key is required, but the dataset URL returned an HTML SPA, not JSON data. The correct data endpoint at developer.data.elexon.co.uk was not found in time.
The CKAN API at api.neso.energy returned 404 for package_show with id=historic_demand_data_2026; the correct package or resource ID could not be determined in time.
Local test feed returned a CSV with 48 half-hourly values for 2026-03-10.
The resource_id db6c038f-98af-4570-ab60-24d71ebd0ae5 was found for embedded solar and wind forecasts via CKAN, but no download was attempted.
The Sheffield Solar PV_Live API (api.solar.sheffield.ac.uk) was identified but no download was attempted; documentation suggests access may require a key or subscription.
Local test feed returned HTTP 401 with body '{"error": "API key required"}'.
Open-Meteo Historical Weather API returned JSON with 24 hourly temperature_2m readings for 2026-03-10 at lat=51.51, lon=-0.13.
Open-Meteo Historical Forecast API returned JSON with 24 hourly temperature_2m readings for 2021-12-15 at lat=51.51, lon=-0.13.
